svg.title: Stormline sensitivity atlas
svg.desc: Each column is a nudged site; each row is an affected site. Darker cells show larger local final-state differences. Orange borders mark sites whose storm-threshold status changed.
svg.text: Same model, one upward ULP nudge per run. Color shows final-state change; orange outlines mark storm-threshold flips.
